notes: Primary pain: post-call summaries inconsistent, agents spending 3-6 min per ticket creating notes
Goal: compress agent after-call wrap-up to <60s via auto-summary + suggested ticket fields
Quote from Head of CX: 'We need summaries that are actionable — show TL;DR, action items, sentiment, and CSAT cues',
Model preferences: open to Llama-variant quantized models for cost; want fallback to larger model for complex calls
Latency target: 90th pctl summary generation <= 300ms for short calls, <= 800ms for full-call transcripts (post-call batch),
Throughput: baseline 1,000 calls/day POC; production ramp expected to 25k calls/day during seasonal spikes
Cost sensitivity: high — wants unit economics (cost per summary) and suggestions from Redwood Optimize
Routing: prefer smart routing by model complexity and SLA; fallbacks to cheaper variant on heavy load
Security: must support SAML SSO, enterprise audit logs, KMS key control; retention controls (30d auto-delete for PII)
Tool-calling: must be able to push structured ticket updates to Zendesk + optional voice-of-customer tags
QA pipeline: human-in-the-loop scoring, auto-regression alerts when summary quality drops; integrate with internal QA dashboard
Spike behavior: holiday promos create 6x baseline call volume for 72h windows — need graceful degradation strategy
POC success metrics: avg. agent wrap time, human QA score >= 4/5, correct ticket field extraction >= 88%, cost per summary < $0.30
Integration notes: sample audio format = 16k mono wav; bilingual transcripts must preserve speaker turn timestamps
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, dedicated sizing guide, POC SOW template — sent Redwood pricing deck (drive link)
